items.title: Multiplying one structure map of a two-one-periodic complex by a parameter of vanishing support
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter chow.tex (Chow Homology), section on periodic complexes and multiplicities
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file chow.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the effect of multiplying one of the two structure maps of a (2,1)-periodic complex by an element x whose support condition dim Supp(M/xM) <= 0 forces x to behave like a parameter: e_R(M, x phi, psi) = e_R(M, phi, psi) - e_R(Im(phi), 0, x), and symmetrically for x psi (statement lines 465-475). The proof has a genuine two-stage reduction: first the x-power torsion submodule is split off and shown to contribute zero to both sides, which uses three vanishing equalities and additivity of e_R, and then in the case where x acts injectively the two kernels are compared and the difference is counted by the displayed short exact sequence ending in the identity for e_R (proof lines 481-509). The author proves only the first of the two formulas and says the second is proved in exactly the same manner; this is reproduced as written. The claim is H2.
